prompt:

No text, borders, gridlines, scenery, ground, shadows or poster composition. Real alpha.

Input2 is locked head/torso context ONLY, showing fixed waist coverage; DO NOT include head/torso in output. Input3 is an independent material-fragment board sampled from approved idle17: black trouser fabric, short side plate, complete knee shell, shin/flex connector, and complete boots. Do not omit the knee shells, shin armor/flex transitions or complete boots. Interpret the same armor construction under each source pose and its actual occlusion. All shared game-frame scale and placement come from the fixed HC/waist design in input2 and the declared common interface, NOT from fragment size. All pose comes ONLY from input1. Frame57 is not idle; do not paste an idle stance into it.
Output P57..P62 only. Each is NEWLY DRAWN from complete hidden upper waist through BOTH hips, shared crotch, both trouser legs, visible armor and BOTH boots. Never generate a full character for later cutting. Never splice separate legs, cut knee/ankle, stretch shin, paste old feet, mirror phases or trim boot bottoms.
All six must share character, facing, palette, outfit proportions, armor design, rendering density and waist registration. Fixed per-slot new hidden black fabric waist interior is x140..180,y160..172 HD, with upper-edge corners(140,160),(180,160). Draw a continuous new root, no second visible belt. It extends naturally into complete hips/trousers below the existing reference belt. Do not draw that belt or torso. These are deliberately designed attachment surfaces, not recovered original hip joints. Same new upper-root design and anchors in all six. Do not enlarge or center each P to fill its slot. Preserve full-window transparent margins.
Follow each original visible leg chain, negative space and occlusion. Left/right are screen sides. Original foot terminal y pairs in logical128:57(91,73),58(88,73),59(83,88),60(73,91),61(74,88),62(87,83). These are surfaces, not support/contact or skeleton. Match the entire visible silhouette and chain, not just endpoints. In58 the right short display is transition(45,70) to tip(46,73); do not expose invented full shin/boot. In61 the left short display is(35,70) to(35,74). 59 reverses low-foot order;61 is recovery, not duplicate60. Preserve all six poses and loop progression.
Generate the ENTIRE six-phase strip in ONE request: exactly six complete P assets, same scale/root, correct slots. No independent single-frame variants. The raw sheet must survive fixed-slot review and shared registration without per-frame bbox fit or local correction.

Do not reproduce the six independent material fragments as output objects. Output six complete hip-to-double-boot assets only, one per requested pose slot. Exactly six P pairs. The three reference images have different roles; only the first two share the output slot geometry.
